The Inheritance

My dear,

If you are reading this, I have finally gone, and you have the key to the attic. Everything you need to know about me is in the old trunk. I have put five locks on it (six, if you count the stubborn one), because I have never liked making things easy.

On the surface, I was an ordinary woman. Deep down… well. Go and see.

All my love, Granny Rose

P.S. Don’t let your Uncle Tom near the trunk. He’s a real pain in the neck.

Who was R. Vane?

PUDDLE JUMPER · OXFORD STREET · 1957 R. Vane

My dear,

So now you know. R. Vane was me: Rose Vane Whitfield. Vane was my mother’s maiden name. I never had it out with your grandfather. He was a steady, gentle man, and I think it would have worried him. On the surface, I was a housewife with a box of old snapshots. Deep down, I was always out there in the rain, waiting for the moment.

Everything in this trunk is yours now. Have a go at something that frightens you, and don’t wait for anybody’s permission.

Granny Rose

“We all need a past – that’s where our sense of identity comes from.”Penelope Lively · quoted in File 1A
